developmentBacklogAddedThisRun.title: Search-result freshness confidence decay
developmentBacklogAddedThisRun.problem: Public search indexes can surface stale job pages as if they were fresh, wasting verification time and inflating false positives.
developmentBacklogAddedThisRun.improvement: Track crawl date, explicit published date and canonical-page activity separately; decay ranking confidence when freshness comes only from crawler recency rather than employer/job metadata.
developmentBacklogAddedThisRun.benefit: Reduces stale leads and prioritizes genuinely new opportunities without deleting existing LIVE items.

developmentBacklogAddedThisRun.title: Remote market-rate sanity band
developmentBacklogAddedThisRun.problem: Remote marketplaces frequently return tiny fixed-price tasks that match skills but are economically irrational compared with stronger LIVE leads.
developmentBacklogAddedThisRun.improvement: Maintain a data-only minimum value band by scope and estimated effort; flag micro-budget e-commerce/admin jobs before full verification while still allowing unusually strategic exceptions.
developmentBacklogAddedThisRun.benefit: Saves screening time and keeps ranking focused on realistic earning opportunities.

writeStatus.blocker: jobs-data.json content freshness remains over the 60-minute SLA, but no qualified content delta was found; fail-closed policy preserved the 39-item authoritative feed rather than performing a timestamp-only replacement.
